triggers.name: new_message_topic
triggers.title: New message in topic
triggers.help: Triggers when a new message is available in the specified Solace topic.

input.name: topics
input.label: Topics
input.hint: One or more topic subscriptions to listen on, e.g. ['orders/created', 'orders/updated'] . Wildcards * (single level) and > (remaining levels) are supported.

input.name: message_type
input.label: Message format
input.hint: Select the message format.

actions.name: acknowledge_message
actions.title: Acknowledge message received from Solace
actions.help: Settles a message received (via a trigger or the receive action) in manual acknowledgement mode, using its acknowledgement handle.

input.name: ack_handle
input.label: Acknowledgement handle
input.hint: The Acknowledgement handle from a trigger or receive output produced in manual acknowledgement mode.

input.name: outcome
input.label: Outcome
input.hint: ACCEPTED consumes the message, FAILED redelivers it, REJECTED routes it to the dead-message queue.

actions.name: publish_to_queue
actions.title: Publish message to queue
actions.help: Publishes a message to the specified Solace queue.

input.name: destination
input.label: Queue name
input.hint: Select a queue, or toggle to enter it manually.

input.name: message_type
input.label: Message format
input.hint: Select the message format.

input.name: delivery_mode
input.label: Delivery mode
input.hint: Messages are PERSISTENT by default. DIRECT is only supported for topics.

input.name: priority
input.label: Priority
input.hint: Message priority (0-255, default 4 ).

input.name: sender_time
input.label: Sender time
input.hint: Sender timestamp in milliseconds.

input.name: time_to_live
input.label: Time to live
input.hint: Broker-enforced time-to-live in milliseconds. This is what actually expires the message (and routes it to the dead message queue when eligible). 0 means it never expires.

input.name: expiration
input.label: Expiration
input.hint: Informational expiration timestamp header, in milliseconds. It does not expire the message on the broker — use Time to live for that.

input.name: user_data
input.label: User data
input.hint: Arbitrary user data header; sent base64-encoded.
